name: PackRat Discord Bridge
description:
Free local companion for the PackRat Discord Voice Panel on CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

PackRat Discord Bridge connects Discord Desktop to the XENEON voice panel without putting Discord credentials inside the widget. It follows your currently selected Discord voice channel, receives the member roster and speaking activity, reads your mute and deafen state, and applies mute or deafen changes requested from XENEON Edge.

Setup is intentionally small: install the plugin, keep Discord Desktop open, and use the Bridge Status action when Discord authorization is required. The status key shows whether Discord is open, authorization is needed, setup is finishing, or the bridge is ready.

The bridge communicates with the XENEON widget only over 127.0.0.1 on your PC. Discord access tokens are kept in memory only and are never sent to the XENEON widget. No user token, message automation, remote account access, or cloud sync is used.

Requires Windows, Discord Desktop, and Stream Deck 7.3 or newer. This plugin is the free companion for the paid PackRat Discord Voice Panel for XENEON Edge.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes: Initial release. Free local companion for PackRat Discord Voice Panel. Native Discord Desktop IPC/RPC connection, automatic current voice channel discovery, roster and speaking updates, mute/deafen state and controls, loopback-only XENEON bridge, memory-only Discord credentials, official Stream Deck SDK v2 and SDKVersion 3.
